_about: Food knowledge for Commute Stopover search. Cuisine values use OpenStreetMap cuisine=* tags. 'groups': a query for the key also matches places tagged with any listed cuisine. 'dishes': terms people search for; a place 'serves' it if its name, description, cuisine tag or scanned menu mentions a term; it 'might serve' it if its cuisine is in strong (likely) or weak (sometimes). 'nameHints': regex on the place name implying a cuisine (for the ~half of places with no cuisine tag). 'chains': brand/name prefix to cuisines and dishes known to be on the menu.
